stylesheets: Only what the frame and the Changelog use: 6 of autolaunch.sh's 48 stylesheets, cut to the rules those use. Each file is wrapped in @scope (:root[data-product="autolaunch"]:has(.shell)) to (.regents-frame): it stops at regents.sh's frame, and :has(.shell) keeps it off the /autolaunch overview, which is regents.sh's own page; html reads :scope. autolaunch.sh sets no product on its page, so its main button, link, focus and chosen colours are restated per theme from Regent UI 69dbfface, so they win over Regent UI's Autolaunch product colours. Its plain links and focus ring are restated at the weight of regents.sh's own rules, which they meet unscoped.
